Point2.description: A sketch point in mm: [x, y] or {"x", "y"}.

SketchTarget.description: The sketch: its feature id or its name (default: the one being edited).

SlotWidth.description: The slot's width in mm: the distance between its two straight sides, and the diameter of its round ends. Positive.

input.description: Draw a slot from the two ends of its whole length and its width.

connect.description:
Make a new point that lands exactly on an existing point (the origin too) coincident with
it. Default: true.

p0.description:
The outer end of one round end, on the slot's axis, as [x, y] or {x, y} in mm. An
expression, a point's id or a snap is not taken.

p1.description: The outer end of the other round end. The distance from `p0` must be more than `width`.

sketch.description: The sketch to draw in: its feature id or name. Default: the one being edited.

width.description: The width of the slot, in mm.

input.title: SlotOverallParams

label: Overall Slot

Created.description: What a command added to its sketch: the ids that the sketch has now and did not before.

constraints.description: Constraint ids, dimensions not among them.

wires.description: The ids of 3D curves, when the command made any.

output.description: What a straight slot returns, including its construction centre and middle point.

constraints.description:
The ids of the constraints added besides the curves' own: a coincident for a point that
landed on an existing one, a point on the curve for a point that was given by id, a radius
for a size given as an expression, what `infer` added.

created.description:
Everything the call added to the sketch: `{points, curves, constraints, dimensions}`, and
`wires` when there are any.

curves.description: The ids of the curves drawn, in order.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

output.title: SlotResult

params: p0, p1: overall ends, width; returns centre_line (construction, between the arc centres) and middle (the point held at its midpoint); connect?: bool (default true: a new point landing exactly on an existing point, the origin too, is made coincident with it). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)
